comments.author: Alrn
comments.body:
The black version of this clothes can be obtained by digging the yellow pillar spots in Halicarnassus / Mausoleum at Halicarnassus' Past.

In game stats:
Durability 40/40
Formality 5
Defence Power 10
Sewing +1
50000 Total Fame required to equip.

This is unisex clothes.
